FN-DG7Z7HH-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 268
Committee: Tourism Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/02/2025
Senate Bill 268 as introduced would create wholesaler and retail licenses to be issued by the
Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Board, to distribute and sell mixed spirit beverages. This
could increase receipts to the State General Fund by an estimated $2.5 million annually from
license fees as follows:
License Type Initial & Renewal License Fees
$550 plus $200 for each
Mixed Spirit Beverage Wholesaler License
additional warehouse
$1,000 plus $200 for each
Beer, Wine, and Mixed Spirit Beverage Wholesaler License
additional warehouse
Mixed Spirit Expanded Retail License $500
Further, this bill levies a privilege or excise tax on the sales of mixed spirit beverages at $0.029
per ounce or fractional part thereof, which would be distributed as follows:
• State General Fund - 50%
• ABC Board - 50%
According to the Board, the estimated tax receipts generated from this new tax levy would result
in an estimated loss of $3.1 million annually.

FN-DG7Z7HH-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 268
Committee: Tourism Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/17/2025
Senate Bill 268 as reported by the Committee on Tourism would create wholesaler and retail
licenses to be issued by the Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Board, to distribute and sell
mixed spirit beverages. This could increase receipts to the State General Fund by an estimated
$2.5 million annually from license fees as follows:
License Type Initial & Renewal License Fees
$550 plus $200 for each
Mixed Spirit Beverage Wholesaler License
additional warehouse
$1,000 plus $200 for each
Beer, Wine, and Mixed Spirit Beverage Wholesaler License
additional warehouse
Mixed Spirit Expanded Retail License $500
This bill could also increase receipts to any county or municipality that levies a complementary
local privilege or license tax by an undetermined amount dependent on the rate of such tax and
the amount of products sold in the respective locality.
Further, this bill levies a privilege or excise tax on the sales of mixed spirit beverages at $0.035
per ounce or fractional part thereof, which would be distributed as follows:
• State General Fund - 50%
• ABC Board - 50%
According to the Board, the estimated tax receipts generated from this new tax levy would result
in an estimated loss of $2.5 million annually.
